quantifiers.parent: every realizable UOM(4,8) parent M and every connected normalized realization cell X_M
quantifiers.family: every proper pairwise-incomparable nine-family S whose individual feasibility loci are nonempty and whose active factor literals are consistent
quantifiers.components: every ordered pair (U,V) of distinct connected components of H_S with U intersection F_S and V intersection F_S nonempty
quantifiers.transport: every labeled residual occurrence, duplicate occurrence, factor orientation, chart overlap, multiwall stratum, recursive parent-boundary stratum, and genuine-infinity stratum

definitions.active_sector: H_S = X_M intersection all active literals epsilon_(S,j) q_j > 0
definitions.master_multigraph: full-dimensional interior factor-sign chambers, with one edge for each connected generic codimension-one wall stratum incident to two chambers
definitions.sector_graph: the master multigraph after retaining the allowed active-factor sign word and contracting/crossing only inactive-factor walls
definitions.minimal_separator: an inclusion-minimal set Delta of active-factor-labeled master edges whose deletion separates chosen chamber vertices u in U and v in V

conditional_theorem.name: compactified-stratification-to-minimal-edge-cut
hypotheses: the committed active-sector theorem, including duplicate-occurrence orientation consistency and all-strata feasibility gluing

a finite source-reconstructible regular stratification K_M of the compactified parent cell, compatible with all parent brackets, all primitive residual factors, chart seams, the recursive parent boundary, and genuine infinity
a coverage certificate proving that every interior chamber and every connected generic interior wall stratum occurs exactly once with complete signed incidence
boundary policy deleting parent-boundary, recursive-facet, chart-only, and genuine-infinity cells from interior adjacency
construction: choose feasible generic chamber vertices u in U and v in V

use path transversality in the open parent cell to identify pi_0(H_S) with pi_0 of the sector graph; codimension-at-least-two multiwalls are avoided, while duplicate codimension-one occurrences are grouped by primitive factor
in the finite master multigraph remove every edge crossing an active factor; u and v are disconnected
choose an inclusion-minimal separating subset Delta of those active edges

for each e in Delta record its connected wall-stratum ID, primitive factor ID, one of the 13 residual orbit types for every occurrence, fixed-unit occurrence orientation, allowed side, incident chamber IDs, chart/overlap IDs, closure incidences, and boundary/infinity tags
certify minimality by one u-v path in the graph with Delta minus {e} deleted for each e in Delta
conditional_theorem.conclusion: Delta is a finite human-checkable minimal separator witness; every edge is generated by a residual occurrence and its aligned support-minimal Gordan circuit, and no path is allowed to glue through a deleted boundary or infinity cell
nonconsequences: the conditional theorem does not construct K_M
it does not bound the number of cells or separator instances
it does not prove any schema instance UNSAT
it does not prove diagonal nine

schema_grammar.multiwall_policy: split every raw zero/sign set into connected regular strata; record all incident chamber germs and Jacobian/rank data; do not infer global incidence from the unordered list of local wall types
schema_grammar.duplicate_policy: group occurrences by primitive factor and retain every raw-to-primitive fixed-unit orientation and multiplicity
schema_grammar.chart_policy: record exact transition and overlap equivalence; a chart seam alone is not a wall
